headline: June Current Account Surplus Hits $49.73 Billion, Setting New All-Time Record
summary: South Korea's June current account posted a record monthly surplus of $49.73 billion, beating the May record of $38.61 billion, the Bank of Korea said. Strong semiconductor exports drove the result.
why: The current account measures a country's trade and income flows with the rest of the world and influences its currency and capital flows.
